date_note: Il Cittadino, published 26 November, says the attack happened that morning.
title: Refrigeration units at Tullio Parmigiani store in Graffignana (Lodi) hit by probable hacker attack, Il Cittadino reports
geo_basis: town named in the article (Graffignana); coordinates approximate
summary: Il Cittadino reports a probable hacker attack on supermarket refrigerators, with the Tullio Parmigiani store in Graffignana hit around 8:30 on 26 November. It says an external digital network reached the units and activated the 'off' and 'defrost' commands. Technicians told the store they were dealing with about thirty similar problems; the article says it is unclear who was targeted.
plain: A local paper says a probable hacker attack switched off fridges at a supermarket in Graffignana. Technicians reportedly have about thirty similar cases. The cause is not confirmed.
exec: Reported probable attack on shop refrigeration; technicians reportedly see about thirty similar problems. Not confirmed.

evidence.quote: alle prese con una trentina di problemi analoghi

validation.note: One local publisher (Il Cittadino); no statement from the store's technicians or an authority was read.

review.note: Compared store, 8:30 time, off/defrost, about thirty problems, unclear target, claim wording against Il Cittadino
